sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed portrait 4:6 photo-booth print background, premium fine-art stationery. Create a single flat artwork, 1024 x 1536 portrait (2:3 aspect). Museum-quality hand-painted watercolor with delicate pigment blooms, translucent washes, detailed natural forms and fine cotton-paper grain. Sophisticated restrained composition, rich but harmonious colors. Place decorative elements along the extreme sides and especially upper and lower corners. Keep the center 70 percent very light and mostly empty so photo windows and editable typography can be placed on top; leave the bottom-center 25 percent pale and calm for readable editable captions. The artwork fills the entire image, no product mockup, no desk, no frame outside the canvas, no photoreal people, no lettering, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
